title: V11 Agent Effectiveness Ledger Line
description: Schema for ONE line of ~/.agent-metrics/agent-effectiveness.jsonl (V11.15). Appended by sync-tasks as a rolling-window snapshot per agent after each reviewed task completes. scripts/agent-effectiveness renders the latest snapshot per agent_id as the per-agent scorecard. ADVISORY ONLY — does not feed DAAO routing in this phase.

tasks_completed.description: Reviewed tasks for this agent in window

avg_difficulty.description: Mean of review.difficulty across the window — contextualizes success_rate

error_count.description: Total errors in window across all reviewed tasks

trend.description: Direction of success_rate vs prior half-window
